method: Town/evening use one fixed after-image letter mask across all three variants: brightest quartile of near-neutral pixels (spread <=15, min channel >150). Waterline uses each image brightest quartile of near-neutral pixels (spread <=15, min channel >=45) to handle water bob; cameras remain fixed. Mean RGB and linear-sRGB contrast against six backing samples. Diagnostic, not WCAG certification.

exposure.meaning: Fixed lighting gain; no meter. Underwater adds EV smoothly over signed depth 0–1.5 m. Lock is a capture compatibility marker only. Look trim multiplies this gain.
